cases.question: On a 40-foot-wide zoning lot, a ventilation air intake is proposed six feet from an interior side lot line. Does that satisfy the ordinary Mechanical Code intake-location rule?

A small café has a total occupant load of 28 people, including employees and customers. The required fixture count can be satisfied with one single-user toilet room. Must separate male and female toilet facilities still be provided?
A building is required to provide four drinking fountains. The designer proposes four bottle-filling stations and no drinking fountains. Is that permitted?

content.text:
- **No.** NYC Mechanical Code § 401.4(1) requires a ventilation air intake opening to be at least **10 feet from a lot line**; six feet from an interior side lot line is therefore less than the stated minimum. ([nyc.gov](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/apps/pdf_viewer/viewer.html?file=2022MC_Chapter4_VentilationWB.pdf&section=conscode_2022&utm_source=openai))
- The special rule for lots **less than 20 feet wide** does not apply on the stated **40-foot-wide** zoning lot; that exception instead places the intake at the centerline between lot lines. ([nyc.gov](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/apps/pdf_viewer/viewer.html?file=2022MC_Chapter4_VentilationWB.pdf&section=conscode_2022&utm_source=openai))
- The supplied Zoning Resolution page identifies the Zoning Resolution as governing land-use and development regulations, but it does not establish the Mechanical Code intake setback. ([zr.planning.nyc.gov](https://zr.planning.nyc.gov/))

{"answerText":"**No.** On the stated 40-foot-wide zoning lot, an intake six feet from an interior side lot line does not satisfy the ordinary rule: ventilation air intake openings must be at least **10 feet** from lot lines or buildings on the same lot (MC § 401.4(1)). The special centerline rule applies only to lots **less than 20 feet wide**, so it does not apply here. The proposed location is 4 feet short of the 10-foot minimum.\n\nThis conclusion addresses the ordinary lot-line location rule only.
